name: Kazama · Windows RDP
description: Windows Server (2025 / 2022) over RDP on Railway — connect with Windows App; optional private access via Tailscale and a built-in Storage Booster. This is an RDP desktop, not a VPS. Needs a Railway Volume at /storage and enough RAM; runs without KVM so it is slow.
readme:
# Kazama — Windows RDP

RDP desktop on Railway (Windows Server inside QEMU). **Not a VPS.**

## Before you deploy
- Attach a **Volume** mounted at `/storage` (Windows needs roughly 20–30 GB).
- Give the service at least **4 GB RAM**.
- Railway has no KVM, so install and boot are **slow**.

## Deploy
1. Set **RDP_PASSWORD** (required) and optionally **WINDOWS_VERSION** (`windows-latest`, `windows-2025`, `windows-2022`).
2. Add a **TCP Proxy** on port `3389`.
3. Watch the deploy logs until Windows finishes installing, then connect with **Windows App** using `<proxy-domain>:<proxy-port>`.

© Kazama · @kazamaofficial-git

RDP_PASSWORD.description: Password for the Windows RDP user. 8+ chars, 3 of: lower/UPPER/digits/symbols, no spaces or < > & " ', must not contain the username.

WINDOWS_VERSION.description: windows-latest (Server 2025), windows-2025 or windows-2022. Only applied at first install; wipe the volume to change later.

RDP_USERNAME.description: Windows administrator username created at first install.

RAM_SIZE.description: RAM given to Windows (must fit your Railway service limit).

DISK_SIZE.description: Virtual disk size (must fit the Railway Volume).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time Railway waits for Windows to shut down cleanly before killing the container.

TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY.description: Optional Tailscale auth key (ephemeral + reusable recommended). When set, RDP is reachable privately over your tailnet — no public TCP Proxy needed. Tailscale must run on the device you connect from.

TAILSCALE_HOSTNAME.description: Machine name shown in your Tailscale admin.

BOOSTER_MODE.description: Storage Booster inside Windows: off, safe (caches/temp), deep (+ DISM ResetBase, hibernation, shadow copies, event logs) or max (+ removes Edge, Firefox, Unity, R, Haskell, Android, Julia, Miniconda, Visual Studio, databases; Chrome is installed/kept). Applied at first install; edit C:\Kazama\kazama.conf later.

BOOSTER_SCHEDULE.description: Automatic Storage Booster run: off, daily or weekly (03:00).

KAZAMA_WALLPAPER.description: Apply the Kazama wallpaper on each user's first logon (true/false).

BOOSTER_KEEP.description: Comma separated catalog ids that max mode must NOT remove (e.g. chrome,visualstudio). See windows/kazama-catalog.psd1.

KAZAMA_TUNE.description: Performance tuning inside Windows for software emulation: off, light (Server Manager, indexing, telemetry, maintenance off) or max (also Defender real-time and Windows Update off). Applied at first install.
